decisionsTitle: «Lista ascunsă»: the name, the glyph, a radio, the event's switch and numbers, its count tick, and «Arată public numărătoarea» on every event (amending §643, §632, §173)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-02**, after BR-V2.62 reached production, of the registration page's new block (an outlined button with a switch glyph, «PUNE ÎN AFARA LOCURILOR», its caption cut off at the right of his phone): «Nu îmi place deloc cum arată bifa asta, trebuia să fie doar radio». Then: «nu vreau să scot pe nimeni de pe listă, ci doar să nu se pună la socoteală; de fapt mai punem bifă pentru „afișarea numărătorii”». Then: «Trebuie ca acest feature să se numească „Pune pe lista ascunsă” cu o iconiță specială cu un bandit (incognito), și la numărate trebuie să am bife dacă vreau să îi includ sau nu.» And: «trebuie să pot invita oameni direct pe lista ascunsă; și tot felul de bife dacă să îi pun la contul total sau nu; și direct din setările evenimentului să pot avea „folosește lista ascunsă” dedicată pentru BIB-uri date pe invitații.»

This amends §643 (the name, the glyph, the radio, the event's switch, the numbers, the ticks), §632 (the «Cine vine» count may include the hidden list when the event says so) and §173 (a second race-number sequence). Inviting people straight onto the hidden list is the invitations chain's tick, renamed at the batch, not this decision's.

**1. The name.** «În afara locurilor» is now **«Lista ascunsă»** / "Hidden list" in every word the club reads: the verbs «Pune pe lista ascunsă» / «Scoate de pe lista ascunsă» ("Put on the hidden list" / "Take off the hidden list"), the chip, the pill «Lista ascunsă: N», the editor's «pe lista ascunsă: N» beside the occupied places, the badge tooltip's «N pe lista ascunsă», the export's last column «Hidden list» (CSV and spreadsheet), the audit label «Pus pe lista ascunsă sau scos de pe ea», the dialogs' titles, bodies and toasts (reworded, the meaning unchanged), and the guide's task «Lista ascunsă: organizatori, pacemakeri, invitați», which gains the switch, the series and the two ticks. `BUSINESS.md`'s vocabulary, `AGENTS.md` §10.5, §10.6 and §15.11, `CLAUDE.md`'s two rows and `SETUP.md` §39 say the new words; the rules are the same. **Not renamed:** the column `registrations.outside_capacity`, its audit action `registration.outside_capacity_changed`, the code's `outsideCapacity` identifiers and the list's `outside=1` parameter — a column rename is a contract migration for a word, and a bookmarked filter keeps working. **Not on a public page.** «Lista ascunsă» is the backoffice's name: it appears on no public page, in no participant's email and in no participant-facing string. Publicly these people are «în afara locurilor anunțate» / "outside the advertised places" (see 7), and the note under «Cine vine» says so in those words: «Cei la start în afara locurilor anunțate (organizatori, voluntari, sportivi invitați) apar în tabel fără să fie numărați: numerele de mai sus numără locurile.» (it said «Organizatorii și invitații clubului…»). The public page marks nobody. **One name, one meaning:** the editor's closed card summaries said «lista ascunsă» for a public participant list switched off («Pe site · 150 de locuri · declarația v3 · lista ascunsă», and the public-list card's «Ascunsă»), which now read as if the hidden list were in use; they say «listă nepublică» and «Nepublică» («public list off», «Not public»).

**2. The glyph.** `hiddenList` in `ACTION_ICONS`: a hat over round glasses, drawn as one path on the 24-unit grid in its own file (`shared/ui/IncognitoIcon.tsx`) — Material has no incognito glyph, and no browser vendor's asset is copied. It is on the block's heading, the row's chip (`HiddenListChip`, which imports the one file rather than the registry) and the list's pill — which, unpressed, is the default colour and outlined like every other summary pill (`ChipLink`), filled in the brand colour while pressed; the row's own chip keeps the secondary colour. `ChipLink` is not reused: it takes a glyph by name from the public pages' registry, which should not gain a backoffice glyph; the pill's link wrapper is ChipLink's, line for line. Not on the confirm button: `ConfirmDialog` draws its own tick on every confirm, and one dialog with a different glyph would be the exception the glyph rule forbids. `tests/unit/shared/action-icons.test.ts` now accepts a drawn glyph — a local file named after its identifier, one per glyph — beside `@mui/icons-material` files.

**3. The radio.** The sentence and the button became a `RadioGroup` of two (`HiddenListRadio`, a client island): «Se numără între locurile evenimentului» and «Pe lista ascunsă», the stored one checked, each a 44-pixel target whose words wrap at 320 pixels. A change opens the existing per-state dialog through the form's own submit (`requestSubmit()`); «Da» posts the same hidden `outside` value to `setOutsideCapacityAction`; «Anulează» sends nothing, and the form now dispatches `CONFIRM_CANCEL_EVENT` on itself so the radio shows the stored state again (a DOM event, because a Server Component passes the form no function). Once a submission ends the radio follows the page the action redirected to, moved or refused. The Organizer sees the two radios disabled. **The overflow** was the caption: an inline `caption` span inside a `Stack` aligned `flex-start` beside an unbreakable uppercase button; the caption is now a block paragraph with `overflow-wrap: anywhere`, the section has `min-width: 0`, and there is no button. Without JavaScript the radios cannot submit (the backoffice's dialogs need it anyway); the server refuses nothing it would not refuse otherwise.

**4. The event's group «Lista ascunsă»** (migration `0126_hidden_list`, expand only, generated by drizzle-kit, with its backfill as an `UPDATE` in the same file, which `yarn migrations:check` classifies as an expand), in the editor's «Lista publică a participanților» card under «Arată public câți așteaptă»:
- «Folosește lista ascunsă» (`hidden_list_enabled`, **off by default**; the migration switched it on for every event that already had a registration on the list, so nothing §643 showed disappears). On, the registration page draws the radio; off, it draws it only for a row already on the list, with the line «Lista ascunsă e oprită la acest eveniment: înscrierea poate doar ieși de pe ea.», and **the server refuses** putting anybody on the list under the event lock (`VALIDATION_ERROR` carrying `HIDDEN_LIST_OFF`, whose sentence names the switch). Taking somebody off is always open. The switch's help says what unticking does and does not: «Debifat: nimeni nou nu intră pe ea; cei deja pe ea rămân, iar pagina îi anunță cât timp au loc; seria lor și numărătoarea se opresc.»
- «Numerele listei ascunse încep de la» (`hidden_list_bib_start`, **empty by default**). See 5.
- «Numără și lista ascunsă» (`hidden_list_counted`, **unticked by default**). See 6.

Beside the group, not in it, «Arată public numărătoarea» (`participant_count_public`, **ticked by default** — named for what it withholds, the participant count) acts on **every event**, whatever the switch says. See 6 and 8.

The two under the switch are shown only while it is ticked (`OnlyWhenTicked`, the `ShownWhen` the mode and the type use: hidden, still posted, read-only while hidden), and act only while it is on (`domain/hidden-list.ts`: `hiddenListCounting`, `hiddenListBibStartOf`); they are stored as posted whatever the switch says, so switching it off and on keeps the club's choices. Saved by the kit's discipline — the group's three by one marker (`event.hiddenList.present`), «Arată public numărătoarea» by its own (`event.participantCountPublic.present`), so a form without them edits none of the four — the group's three audited as `event.hidden_list_changed` and «Arată public numărătoarea» as its own `event.participant_count_public_changed` (it acts on every event, so an event that never uses the hidden list does not read in its trail as if the hidden list had moved), each with `from` and `to` naming only what moved; neither has a label in the catalogues, as §634's tick has none — no screen lists an event's trail — previewed, carried to the later dates of a series by a scoped save (each date's own trail row) and by «Repetă evenimentul» and a duplicate; the save expires the public pages as every event save does. Every help is one sentence under 200 characters in both languages. The three public notes this decision writes or rewrites under «Cine vine» and beside the places run longer (282–518 characters), as the list's existing notes do (431–612): they are the established exception to the 200-character rule, one note each, not split.

**5. Race numbers (amending §173).** With a hidden-list start set and the switch on, `pickBibNumber` draws from **two series that never meet**: a row on the hidden list from its start upward, a counted row from `bib_start_number` — each the lowest free number in its series, so each in confirmation order. The hidden series runs up to the race's start when it sits below it, else to the ceiling; the race's runs up to the hidden start when that sits above it. Both the confirmation's draw and «Alocă numerele» use it. **A number once given stays** when a row changes list (§173: a printed bib is never renumbered). **The save's collision rule:** a start inside the race's capped series (`bib_start_number` … `bib_start_number + capacity − 1`) is refused naming the box; on an uncapped event, whose series has no end, so is any start at or above the race's first number — there the hidden series sits below the race's (`fields.ts#hiddenListBandIssue`); and so is one whose series would hold any of the desk's reserved spares (both in `service.ts#assertHiddenListNumbers`, which needs the event row, and names the box, so the editor points at it rather than only saying «Verifică datele introduse»): the series is the one the draw uses (`bibs.ts#seriesBounds`), from the start to the race's first number less one when it sits below it, otherwise to the ceiling, so a start below spares that sit above the race (race 1–150, spares 200–219, a start at 160) is refused as well as one inside them; judged only while the switch is on, and only on a save that moves the start (see the second review round below). **A full series never refuses a confirmation:** when the race's series has run into the hidden start (more confirmed than the room, or a start the save did not see), the draw falls back to the next free number above, as every draw did before there were two. **The spares and the hidden series (amending §444).** The first print reserved its spares after the highest number anybody has — with a hidden series at 900 and invitations holding 900–902, the spares became 903–922, the next hidden-list confirmations jumped to 923 and walk-ins wore numbers inside the dedicated series. With the hidden series above the race's, the first print's «highest» is now taken over the numbers below the hidden start, and no spare reaches it, on a first print or an extension (`spare-bibs.ts#spareStopOf`, `nextSpareCandidates`' `stop`; the card's next range and the print read the same function); a print with no room left before the hidden start is refused with `SPARES_BEFORE_HIDDEN_LIST`, whose sentence names «Numerele listei ascunse încep de la» («Numerele de rezervă nu mai încap înainte de seria listei ascunse. Mută mai sus «Numerele listei ascunse încep de la», în setările evenimentului, sau tipărește mai puține.»). A hidden series below the race's bounds nothing: the spares come after the race's numbers as before. Unchanged: spares are still never drawn, and the desk's number typed by hand may be any free number as before.

**6. The public list (amending §632, §643).** «Arată public numărătoarea» off: «Cine vine» has no number in its title, no counted line, no «Apar cu numele și» count and no position column — a running position is a count — only the names (and the race number behind its own notice gate, §613), with the note's sentence about the title's number dropped. «Numără și lista ascunsă» on: the title and «confirmați» count everybody on the hidden list with a place, ticked or not (`countHiddenListWithPlace`: real rows only, confirmed among the confirmed, a hold among «în curs de confirmare» on a capped event only — an uncapped event still publishes no head count of held places, §32), the ticked hidden-list pending count in «Apar cu numele și», and the note that the hidden list is not counted is gone. **The places line, the free places and every capacity count never include the hidden list** — it takes no place, which is the point. **The rows never change because of either tick** (§32): which names appear is the person's tick and the notice's gates alone; an unticked runner on the hidden list is not even a «Participant (nume ascuns)» row, as before. So that the title, the rows and the note agree while the hidden list is counted, the note then adds one sentence: «Numerele de mai sus îi numără și pe cei la start în afara locurilor anunțate (organizatori, voluntari, sportivi invitați); dintre ei, în tabel apar doar cei care au ales să apară.» The cached counts gained the key part `"hidden-list"` with the new shape. An event whose switch is off never counts the hidden list, whatever «Numără și lista ascunsă» says; «Arată public numărătoarea» acts on it all the same (8).

**7. Clean, fair, configurable — the public side.** While an event's «Folosește lista ascunsă» is on — or while anybody real on the hidden list still holds a place, confirmed or a hold, since unticking the switch takes nobody off and they still start outside the advertised places — the event page's places line — «N înscriși din M locuri» beside the register button (`RegistrationCta`, every state that draws it: open, full with a waiting list, full without one), the one place a visitor reads the places — carries one sentence: «Organizatorii, voluntarii și sportivii invitați pot fi la start în afara locurilor anunțate; ei nu ocupă din aceste locuri.» / "Organisers, volunteers and invited runners may be at the start outside the advertised places; they take none of them." It names nobody and says nothing of how many. Whether anybody on the list holds a place is the start list's cached count (`places.start-list-counts`, keyed `"hidden-list"`, expired by every registration change); the editor's preview, which neither fills nor reads the public cache (§579), says the sentence by the switch alone. Off with nobody on the list holding a place, nothing; an uncapped event, which advertises no places and draws no places line, nothing. The switch is the event page's own row, whose cache key gained `"hidden-list"` with the row's shape (the switch and the two ticks), so no entry written before the columns existed is read as "off" after the release; every event save expires it. Nothing in the code reads a member flag or a staff role to decide a place: the hidden list's one exclusion is the audited column `registrations.outside_capacity`, set only by an Administrator's audited verb.

**8. «Arată public numărătoarea» on every event (the review round, 2026-10-02).** The owner asked for a tick on showing the public count («mai punem bifă pentru afișarea numărătorii») before the hidden list existed, and «configurable» means any event may keep its public numbers to itself — not only one that uses the hidden list. So the tick left the group: in the editor it sits beside «Arată public câți așteaptă», not indented and never hidden, with its own marker and its help; `hiddenListCounting` reads it whatever «Folosește lista ascunsă» says, so on any event, unticked, «Cine vine» has no «(N)» in its title, no «N confirmați — M cu numele afișat» line, no «în curs» words and no position column, and the rows stay as they are. «Numără și lista ascunsă» and the hidden list's number series stay under the switch. The column, its default (true, so nothing changes on production until the club unticks it on an event) and the migration are unchanged; the cache key part `"hidden-list"` already carries the column. Its trail is its own action (4).

**The review round's numbers note (2026-10-02).** The sentence that the numbers count people with no row («Numerele de mai sus îi numără și pe cei la start în afara locurilor anunțate…») follows the headline's own condition: the hidden list's holds count toward it only where the headline adds them — a capped event's known counts — so on an uncapped event, or where the door read no counts, a hidden-list hold alone does not bring the note.

**The second review round (2026-10-03).** *The save judges the hidden start only when it moves.* The band rule was a refinement of the form's schema, so every save judged the stored start against the posted places: «Trimite-i oferta» adds a supplementary place without a save (§642), and on a race of 150 with the hidden list at 151 it carries the race's series to 1–151, after which every save of the event — a word fixed in the description — was refused until the Administrator moved the start. The rule now lives in the service (`service.ts#assertHiddenListNumbers`, its band sentence `fields.ts#hiddenListBandIssue`) and judges a save that moves the hidden start, switches «Folosește lista ascunsă» on, or moves the race's first number or its places, and every new event; a save posting all of them as stored passes. No save moves the spares — only the print writes them, and it already stops before the hidden start. The spares the check reads are the row `lockEventForCapacity` returns inside the save's transaction — the lock taken on an uncapped event too while the start is judged — so a print committing between the editor's read and the write cannot reserve numbers inside the series being saved. *Room above the race's series.* A start right after the race's last place (151 for 150) is accepted, but leaves no room for a supplementary place, a retired number (§173) or the desk's spares; the box's help now says to leave room above it («de exemplu 900 la 150 de locuri»), and its «?» (`hiddenListBibStartHelpMore`, each under §511's 200 characters) says what the room is for and states the one fallback plainly: a series with no free number left takes the next free number after it, in the other series if need be, and no number is ever given twice. `SETUP.md` §39 says the same, and that the save refuses a start whose series would run into the desk's spare numbers, not only one inside them.

**The third review round (2026-10-03).** *Every date a save reaches is judged, not only the one saved.* A scoped series save (`applyToSeries`) carries the switch, the hidden start, the race's first number and its places to the other dates, but only the saved date went through the rule, while a date may hold its own places (a supplementary one, §642) or its own spares (§444). Now, when a scoped save carries any of those four columns, each date's row as the save leaves it is judged by the same rule as the saved date's — moved against that date's stored row, or not judged — its spares read from the row `lockEventForCapacity` returns for that date inside the save's transaction; a refusal names the box and the date (see the fourth round for the sentence) and, thrown in the one transaction, writes nothing on any date. *A copy is judged too.* A duplicate and every date «Repetă evenimentul» makes carry the source's switch, start, places and first number and none of its spares, so the band alone is judged (`service.ts#assertCopiedHiddenList`): a source whose places «Trimite-i oferta» carried up to its hidden start is refused a duplicate or a repeat before anything is written — the repeat before its rule is stored. The maintenance job's standing series skip such a source, making none of its dates until it is saved right, and go on with the others rather than failing the run (the fourth round makes the skip counted).

**The fourth review round (2026-10-03).** *A refusal of the hidden start says why, in words.* The new refusals reached the Administrator as «Verifică datele introduse»: the actions sent back the bare `VALIDATION_ERROR`, and the events list, the repeat panel and the editor translate only the code, so a duplicate refused by the source's hidden list said nothing of the box, and a scoped save's refusal on another date never showed that date — only the developers' message did. The refusal is now a `HiddenListNumbersError` (`domain/hidden-list.ts`): still a `VALIDATION_ERROR` about `hiddenListBibStart`, so the editor still links the box, carrying which refusal it is — `HIDDEN_LIST_IN_RACE_SERIES` (inside the race's series, or the places have reached it) or `HIDDEN_LIST_ON_SPARES` (through the desk's spares) — and, when another date of a series refused it, that date. The actions (`hiddenListOutcome`) turn it into `Admin.errors.<marker>`, or `<marker>_DATED` with `{date}` filled in the reader's language («Pe miercuri, 21 oct. 2026, «Numerele listei ascunse încep de la» ar cădea în seria cursei: data aceea are mai multe locuri…»): the editor's save and create, «Repetă evenimentul» (with no box linked, since the box is the settings', not the panel's) and the events list's duplicate. Each of the four sentences names the box in both languages and says nothing was saved. A copy's sentence names no date: a duplicate and a repeat are refused by the source's own settings, which is where the box is; the date stays in the log message. *A standing series that stopped is never silent.* `materializeStandingRepeats` caught every `VALIDATION_ERROR` of a series and left no trace, while the maintenance run counted only a throw — a series whose source's places had been carried up to its hidden start stopped making dates for good and nobody was told. The catch is now the hidden list's refusal alone (`HiddenListNumbersError`); any other refusal fails the step as before. The function returns the refused sources' ids beside the count, and the maintenance run logs each («[series] no new dates: …», the event's id, never a name) and adds each to the run's `errorCount`, every run until the start is moved.

**Not changed.** The capacity formula and its one exclusion; the allocator, the transitions and the refill (§643); `kind` in no condition; the Organizer's rights (§289); the emails; the public list's disclosure gates (§396, §628, §634).

**Refused.**
- **Removing hidden-list people from the public list.** The owner: «nu vreau să scot pe nimeni de pe listă». The ticks change numbers, never rows.
- **Counting the hidden list in the places line** («150 de înscriși din 150 de locuri», the free places) when «Numără și lista ascunsă» is on: the line counts places, and the hidden list takes none; counted there, a full race would read over its capacity.
- **Renaming the column and the audit action**: a contract migration for a word.
- **The backoffice's word on a public page** («Pe lista ascunsă», a «hidden list» badge): the public reads «în afara locurilor anunțate», one sentence beside the places, and no row is marked.
- **A second capacity** for the hidden list: it has no limit of its own; the club decides each row, audited.
- **Renumbering anybody** when the series is set or a row changes list: a number once given is printed and emailed.
- **Dropping the public sentence the moment the switch is unticked** while somebody on the list still holds a place: «150 înscriși din 150 locuri» with more at the start is what the sentence exists to prevent.
- **A hidden series above an uncapped race's first number**: the race's series has no end, so the two would meet.
- **Spares inside the hidden series**, and spares pushed above the invitations' numbers: the print stops before the hidden start instead.
changelogLine: - **«Lista ascunsă»** — «În afara locurilor» is now the hidden list, with an incognito glyph and two radios on the registration's page; the event's settings gain «Folosește lista ascunsă», with the hidden list's own race-number series (the desk's spares stay below it; the start is checked only when a save moves it, so a supplementary place never blocks the next save, and on every date a series save, a duplicate or a repeat reaches — a refusal says in words which box to move and, for another date of the series, which date; a standing series it stops is counted as an error of the maintenance run) and «Numără și lista ascunsă» under it, and, on every event, «Arată public numărătoarea» (ticked by default) to keep «Cine vine»'s numbers off the page; while the switch is on, or anybody on the list holds a place, the event page says beside the places that organisers, volunteers and invited runners may start outside the advertised places. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: «Lista ascunsă» on a registration's page is two radios, «Se numără între locurile evenimentului» and «Pe lista ascunsă», the stored state checked, under a heading with the incognito glyph, drawn while the event's «Folosește lista ascunsă» is on or for a row already on the list — then with the line «Lista ascunsă e oprită la acest eveniment: înscrierea poate doar ieși de pe ea.»; the Administrator's form posts the hidden `outside` value opposite to the stored state, a change opens the existing per-state dialog, «Da» posts it to `setOutsideCapacityAction`, «Anulează» sends nothing and shows the stored state again, and the Organizer sees both radios disabled, with no form (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Criterion 23 (amended): «Dă-i un loc acum» on a registration on «Lista ascunsă» gives it its place whatever the counts — it needs no counted free place, so a full event does not refuse it and no lapsed declaration hold goes for it — while a counted row on the same full event is still refused with §589's sentence (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Criterion 24 (amended): Choosing «Pe lista ascunsă» for a waiting row or an open offer opens the «Pui înscrierea pe lista ascunsă?» dialog, which names the declaration's email «{message}» and the bold email line for a real row, and for a TEST row neither — its body names the declaration to sign and no email (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Putting a registration on the hidden list of an event whose «Folosește lista ascunsă» (`events.hidden_list_enabled`, off by default, switched on by migration 0126 for every event already holding such a row) is off is refused under the event lock with `VALIDATION_ERROR` carrying `HIDDEN_LIST_OFF`, whose sentence names the switch, and changes nothing; taking one off is allowed whatever the switch says (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

At 320 pixels the «Lista ascunsă» section, its radios' labels and its caption stay inside the screen with no horizontal scroll, and each radio's row is at least 44 pixels tall (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Criterion 191 (amended): The registrations list's summary strip shows «Lista ascunsă: N» with the incognito glyph — outlined in the default colour like every other pill, filled in the brand colour while pressed — while any real registration is on the hidden list, a link that filters the list to them (`outside=1`, kept beside the state in force, the strip's counts unchanged by it), each such row wears the «Lista ascunsă» chip, the «Înscrieri» badge's «cu loc» and confirmed figures leave them out while the tooltip's event line ends «, N pe lista ascunsă», the event's «Înscrierile primite» says «pe lista ascunsă: N» beside the occupied places, and the CSV and spreadsheet end with «Hidden list» and, with the pill pressed (`outside=1`), hold only those rows; «Când se pierde un loc» counts no hidden-list row among the held places, the lapsed ones or the offers; only an Administrator puts a row on the list or takes it off, from the registration's page, each change audited as `registration.outside_capacity_changed` with from and to — the Organizer is refused (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

With the hidden list's own series set (`events.hidden_list_bib_start`) and the switch on, a confirmed row on the hidden list draws the lowest free number from that start and a counted row from `bib_start_number` up to the number before it, each in confirmation order, at the confirmation and in «Alocă numerele»; a number once given stays when the row changes list; without a series, or with the switch off, every row draws from the race's series; a series with no free number left takes the next free number after it — in the other series if need be, never a number already given — rather than refusing the confirmation, and the box's help asks for room above the race's series while its «?» says the room is for supplementary places and the desk's spares and states this fallback (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The event save refuses a hidden-list start inside the race's capped series (`bib_start_number` to `bib_start_number + capacity − 1`), or at or above the race's first number on an uncapped event, naming «Numerele listei ascunse încep de la», and one whose series (from the start to the race's first number less one when it sits below it, otherwise to the ceiling) would hold any of the desk's reserved spares — a start below spares that sit above the race as well as one inside them — naming the same box (`fields: ["event.hiddenListBibStart"]`), the spares read from the event row locked inside the save's transaction (on an uncapped event too); it judges neither while the switch is off, and judges only a save that moves the hidden start, switches «Folosește lista ascunsă» on, or moves the race's first number or its places, and every new event — a save posting all of them as stored passes, so a place «Trimite-i oferta» added (§642) that carries the race's series up to a hidden start set just above it (race 1–150, hidden 151, capacity now 151) never refuses the event's next ordinary save, while a save moving the places to 152 is refused; a scoped series save judges every other date it reaches the same way, against that date's own row — its places and its spares, read from that date's row locked inside the save's transaction — and a refusal names the date and writes nothing on any date; a duplicate and «Repetă evenimentul» judge the band on the source's values and refuse before writing anything or storing the rule, while the maintenance job skips such a source and goes on with the others (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

A refused hidden-list start reaches the Administrator as its own sentence, never «Verifică datele introduse»: `Admin.errors.HIDDEN_LIST_IN_RACE_SERIES` (inside the race's series, or its places have reached it) or `HIDDEN_LIST_ON_SPARES` (through the desk's spares), each naming «Numerele listei ascunse încep de la» / «The hidden list's numbers start at» — on the editor's save, with the box linked, on «Repetă evenimentul», with no box linked, and on the events list after a refused duplicate; a scoped series save refused on another date's places or spares answers `HIDDEN_LIST_IN_RACE_SERIES_DATED` or `HIDDEN_LIST_ON_SPARES_DATED` with `{date}` that date in the reader's language, while a copy's sentence names no date (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

A standing series whose source the hidden list refuses makes none of its dates while every other series still gets its own; `materializeStandingRepeats` returns that source's id among `refused`, the maintenance run logs it and adds one to its `errorCount` for each such source on every run until the start is moved, and any other refusal of a series still fails the step (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

With the hidden list's series above the race's, the desk's spares stay below it: the first print reserves after the highest number below the hidden start — invitations holding 900–902 never push the spares to 903 — no print or extension reaches the hidden start, both series' draws skip the spares, and a print with no room left before it is refused with `SPARES_BEFORE_HIDDEN_LIST`, whose sentence names «Numerele listei ascunse încep de la»; a hidden series below the race's bounds nothing (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Criterion 10 (amended): Given an event, when a registration is confirmed or the batch runs, then it is given the lowest free race number in its own series — the race's, from the event's own `bib_start_number` (1 by default), or, for a row on «Lista ascunsă» of an event whose switch is on and whose hidden list has its own series (`hidden_list_bib_start`), the hidden list's, from that start; the race's series ends at the number before the hidden start when that sits above it, and the hidden list's at the number before `bib_start_number` when it sits below it — in order, never at random, the desk's spares and retired numbers skipped; a series with no free number left takes the next free number after it, in the other series if need be, never a duplicate; under the same event-row lock capacity uses; a number once given is never renumbered, stays when the row changes list, and a cancelled registration keeps it (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Criterion 25 (amended): Given an event that takes registrations here, when an Administrator types how many spares (1 to 50) and presses «Tipărește», then, asked first with the first number named, the event's reservation of desk spares is made under the event-row lock. The first print takes the numbers right after the highest number anybody has, settled, provisional or erased — when the hidden list's own series sits above the race's, the highest below the hidden list's first number. A later print extends the reservation after its end, stepping over any number somebody holds. Neither reaches the hidden list's first number: a print with no room left before it is refused with `SPARES_BEFORE_HIDDEN_LIST`, naming «Numerele listei ascunse încep de la». A start that moved since the question is refused and nothing is written. The reservation is stored as a start and a count, both or neither, at most 500 numbers and within five digits (checked at the database), and audited with the range, never a name (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Criterion 30 (amended): Three registrations confirmed in a different order than they were sent are numbered in the order of confirmation, from the first number of their own series — the event's own first number, or, for rows on «Lista ascunsă» of an event with the hidden list's own series, that series' first number (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Criterion 12 (amended): A print of 1 to 50 spares reserves the numbers after the highest number any registration holds (settled, provisional or erased) on a first print — below the hidden list's first number when its own series sits above the race's — and the next free numbers after the reservation on a second, neither reaching the hidden list's first number. A number an extension steps over stays its holder's and is never a spare. The reservation is at most 500 numbers and within five digits (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The «Lista ascunsă» group's three settings are saved by one marker and «Arată public numărătoarea» by its own (a form without a marker edits none of its fields), the group's audited as `event.hidden_list_changed` and the count's tick as `event.participant_count_public_changed`, each naming only what moved, carried by a scoped series save, «Repetă evenimentul» and a duplicate, and carried by the editor's preview; the two under the switch are shown only while it is ticked, and «Arată public numărătoarea» is shown on every event beside «Arată public câți așteaptă»; the editor's summaries call a public participant list that is off «listă nepublică» and «Nepublică», never «lista ascunsă» (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

«Cine vine» shows the same rows whatever the ticks say; with «Numără și lista ascunsă» on and the switch on, its title and «confirmați» count every real hidden-list registration with a place (holds among «în curs de confirmare» on a capped event only), the not-counted note is gone and the note says instead that the numbers count them too and that only those who chose to appear are in the table; with «Arată public numărătoarea» off — on any event, the hidden list on or off — it shows no number in the title, no counted line, no «în curs» words and no position column; the places line and the free places never count the hidden list; with the switch off the hidden list is never counted; no rendering of it says «lista ascunsă» or "hidden list" (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Criterion 30 (amended): A confirmed registration on «Lista ascunsă» whose person ticked the list appears in the table like any ticked confirmed runner, with no public marker; unless the event counts the hidden list («Numără și lista ascunsă» with «Folosește lista ascunsă» on) it is left out of «Cine vine (N)», the «N confirmați — M cu numele afișat» line and the in-progress count, and it is always left out of the places line; an unticked one is not even a «Participant (nume ascuns)» row; while the numbers are said and such a row is in the table, the note under it adds «Cei la start în afara locurilor anunțate (organizatori, voluntari, sportivi invitați) apar în tabel fără să fie numărați: numerele de mai sus numără locurile.» when the hidden list is not counted, and «Numerele de mai sus îi numără și pe cei la start în afara locurilor anunțate (organizatori, voluntari, sportivi invitați); dintre ei, în tabel apar doar cei care au ales să apară.» when it is; the disclosure gates are unchanged (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

A registration on the hidden list (`registrations.outside_capacity`) stays out of every term of the capacity formula whatever the event's «Folosește lista ascunsă», «Numără și lista ascunsă» and «Arată public numărătoarea» say: the free places, the places line and the waiting list's turn never count it (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Criterion 21 (amended): A registration on «Lista ascunsă» (the hidden list, `registrations.outside_capacity`) is in no term of the capacity formula in any state — confirmed, a declaration hold, an open offer or a family's reservation; the allocator gives it a place directly whatever the counts and never waitlists or refuses it for want of one, `fillAvailableSpots` never offers it anything and no stale-hold sweep releases its hold for somebody waiting; every change of list serves the line first under the event lock (`fillAvailableSpots` after the stale holds expire, even when the press changes nothing), putting a row that holds a counted place on the list releases that place and the ordinary refill follows, putting a `WAITLISTED` row, or a `WAITLIST_OFFERED` one, on the list gives it a declaration hold at once with the ordinary deadline and one `COMPLETE_DECLARATION` queued (an offer's queued email never tried withdrawn), so past the offer's deadline `expireStaleHolds` leaves it `PENDING_DECLARATION` and `findEventsNeedingMaintenance` does not select its event for it — `WAITLISTED` and `WAITLIST_OFFERED -> PENDING_DECLARATION` only for a hidden-list row, and taking off the list a row that would hold a counted place is refused with `NoFreePlaceError` unless `occupied < capacity` once the line is served — so a hold released for a waiting runner is offered to them, never taken by the row taken off — so two connections racing for the last place while a row comes off the list never end above capacity; a cancelled or expired hidden-list row restarted through the form comes back counted, the mark cleared and journalled; only the column is a condition, `kind` none (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

While an event's «Folosește lista ascunsă» is on, or while any real registration on the hidden list holds a place (confirmed or a hold) with the switch off, its places line («N înscriși din M locuri») is followed by «Organizatorii, voluntarii și sportivii invitați pot fi la start în afara locurilor anunțate; ei nu ocupă din aceste locuri.» (English likewise) in every state that draws the line; with the switch off and nobody on the list holding a place, or on an uncapped event, nothing; no string of a public catalogue namespace (anything but `Admin` and `Feedback`) says «lista ascunsă» or "hidden list" (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Criterion 68 (amended): /admin/emails foresees no offer to the next in line and no lapse email at the deadline of a declaration hold on «Lista ascunsă», which the maintenance job never releases for anybody, and keeps that row's own last call as foreseen (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

With «Numără și lista ascunsă» on, the note that the numbers count people the table does not show appears only when the numbers above it include somebody on the hidden list: its confirmed, or its holds only where the headline adds them (a capped event's known counts); on an uncapped event a hidden-list hold alone brings no such note (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Criterion 36 (amended): A declaration link minted for a registration that holds a declaration replaces that registration's live waiting-list offer link: the offer link is refused as `SUPERSEDED`, its `superseded_by_token_id` names the declaration link and its page says a newer email has the working link, so an open offer put on «Lista ascunsă» leaves one working link to sign with (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Lista ascunsă»: the name, an incognito glyph, a radio, the event's switch, the hidden list's own numbers and its count tick, and «Arată public numărătoarea» on every event
